structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import Model
from tests.llm_router.support.fault_server import (
    ScriptedHTTPServer,
    ScriptedResponse,
)
from tests.llm_router.support.workers.retry import (
    google_error_response,
    google_generate_path,
    openai_chat_path,
    openai_error_response,
    run_retry_worker,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_PROVIDER_ERROR_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
def test_provider_rejections_surface_as_provider_error() -> None:
    openai_path = openai_chat_path()
    google_path = google_generate_path(model=Model.GEMINI_FLASH)
    private_detail = "provider-private-detail"

    openai_routes = {
        ("POST", openai_path): [
            ScriptedResponse(
                status_code=400,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                body=openai_error_response(status_code=400, message=private_detail),
            )
        ]
    }

    google_routes = {
        ("POST", google_path): [
            ScriptedResponse(
                status_code=400,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                body=google_error_response(status_code=400, message=private_detail),
            )
        ]
    }

    with (
        ScriptedHTTPServer(port=0, routes=openai_routes) as openai_server,
        ScriptedHTTPServer(port=0, routes=google_routes) as google_server,
    ):
        openai_result = run_retry_worker(
            case="openai",
            scenario="non_retryable",
            server_base_url=openai_server.base_url,
        )
        assert openai_result.ok is False
        assert openai_result.error_type == "ProviderError"
        assert private_detail not in (openai_result.error_message or "")
        assert openai_server.request_count("POST", openai_path) == 1

        google_result = run_retry_worker(
            case="google",
            scenario="non_retryable",
            server_base_url=google_server.base_url,
        )
        assert google_result.ok is False
        assert google_result.error_type == "ProviderError"
        assert private_detail not in (google_result.error_message or "")
        assert google_server.request_count("POST", google_path) == 1
